contentPattern.structure: per card: image (top) + title + short description

suitableFor: 'explore more' editorial card grids on a highlighted/grey section
image-led tiles with image on top, then title + one-line description
related-content or discovery card rows beneath a section heading
notSuitableFor: text-first service tiles with image below (use cards-service)
promotional cards with CTA buttons (use cards-promo)
